flow_control.intake_condition: Exact API/source ownership, original baseline/helper closure, stable dependency interface and resource plan agreed
flow_control.stop_new_intake_when: Three complete native handoffs await integration or one full3-5-module cohort is acceptance-blocked
flow_control.reassign_on_backlog: Use free seats on the real integration/ordinary-test/baseline/performance blocker instead of another large implementation wave
flow_control.shared_abi: One owner for each shared session/base-derived interface; batch caller changes and affected consumer rebuilds
flow_control.rust_composition: Prefer direct safe Rust helper/core reuse once both sides migrate; identify Rust-to-C++-to-Rust round trips and retire them in connected cohorts
flow_control.configuration: Keep Default/compiler/flags stable; no one-off configuration per module
flow_control.quiet_sampling: Existing competing native work must settle. ReserveCPU4 and verify affinity before startup. No builds/tests/bulk hashing or copying during sampling.
flow_control.low_memory: Preserve completed artifacts and resume the exact unfinished launch only; never lower the guard or restart completed work because observation yielded

handoff_contract.no_partial_completion_claim: One migrated helper is not a complete directory/subsystem. Large families remain partial until their owned scope and seams close.
handoff_contract.deferred_checks: Sanitizer/fuzz campaigns and security-focused side work remain off until explicitly resumed; deferred checks are not passes.
handoff_contract.rejection: Stop the rejected action. Do not rephrase, reroute to another agent or retry to bypass the rejection; continue unrelated authorized work.
handoff_contract.publication: Preserve all cases/history/negative results and unchanged batch membership/gate. No performance acceptance or publication follows from code/native counts.

progress_and_scaling.percentage_owner: Parent scope/credit calculation; this routing plan does not invent a completion fraction
track_actual: Configured queue/build time and rebuild cause
progress_and_scaling.measure_throughput: Use weighted accepted scope per wall hour after the denominator is established, handoff queue depth/age, integration failure causes and memory overlap. Counts of generated Rust or native handoffs alone are not delivery.
progress_and_scaling.scale_when: A stable independent contract/source family is ready and delivery queue remains within cap. Keep extra seats on acceptance work when RAM/build/integration is saturated.
progress_and_scaling.calendar_eta: Not estimated here; requires measured weighted accepted throughput across multiple comparable cohorts, with uncertainty and platform/provider gaps.

dependency_edge_semantics.requires: Final connected integration prerequisites, not universal implementation-start barriers
dependency_edge_semantics.implementation_can_overlap: An owner can port local Rust policy against an agreed existing native primitive while another pod ports that provider; record the temporary seam/cost and retire it after both sides integrate
hard_start_blockers: Unagreed or concurrently changing shared ownership/ABI contract
Missing independently original policy/helper baseline before production mutation
Unavailable native resource window for the next compiler/test step
